camera_interface: Bare PCB, four M2 through screws. Adjustable square-pitch slots 26..30 mm are design capability, NOT a claimed camera measurement.
cross_bolts: 2 x M4 x 40, flat washers and M4 nuts; no printed threads
axial_adjustment: M3 x 6 socket head, M3 nut; recessed head. Press rail front end and seat indexing keys before cross-clamping
geometry_coordinate: X rail forward, Y rail width, Z outward from rail root. Side-rail placement Rx(-90 deg), then translate(20,54,30).
